causal-backed-gain.definition: Causal-only already improves over baseline, and corr-union does not reverse that gain.
causal-backed-gain.inclusion_rule: delta_wf1_vs_base > 0 for causal-only; corr does not reduce below baseline-level recovery.
causal-backed-gain.exclusion_rule: Do not use when corr causes clear regression against causal-only with harmful FP propagation.

corr-added-gain.definition: Corr-union yields additional improvement beyond causal-only on the same trace.
corr-added-gain.inclusion_rule: delta_corr_vs_causal > 0 with evidence of added true-positive recovery or better joint/localization behavior.
corr-added-gain.exclusion_rule: Do not use when improvement comes only from noisy FP increases without meaningful TP recovery.

causal-preserving-neutral.definition: Corr-union is approximately neutral relative to causal-only while preserving causal behavior.
causal-preserving-neutral.inclusion_rule: Near-zero net change vs causal-only and no material new harmful error pattern.
causal-preserving-neutral.exclusion_rule: Do not use if corr clearly helps or harms in a direction that changes mechanism interpretation.

corr-induced-harm.definition: Corr-union degrades behavior relative to causal-only due to over-propagation or spurious triggering.
corr-induced-harm.inclusion_rule: delta_corr_vs_causal < 0 with evidence of added FP chains, localization drift, or wrong-category spread.
corr-induced-harm.exclusion_rule: Do not use for cases where all variants fail similarly without corr-specific harm.

shared-failure.definition: Baseline, causal-only, and corr-union all fail on the key gold signal(s).
shared-failure.inclusion_rule: Core gold categories remain missed across all variants; no variant offers meaningful recovery.
shared-failure.exclusion_rule: Do not use if any variant has clear mechanism-consistent recovery.

pattern_tag_definitions.missing-context-recovery: Model recovers a gold error after graph signal supplies context that was absent in baseline/causal pass.
pattern_tag_definitions.dependency-chain-recovery: Recovery follows a plausible upstream->downstream dependency chain consistent with error propagation logic.
pattern_tag_definitions.precision-preserving-correction: Gain occurs with minimal added FP categories; precision is largely preserved.
pattern_tag_definitions.late-stage-recovery: Improvement appears at later reasoning/trace stages rather than initial detection stage.
pattern_tag_definitions.causal-anchor-dominant: Observed behavior is mainly explained by intervention-validated causal edges rather than corr additions.
pattern_tag_definitions.weak-signal-augmentation: Corr edges amplify weak but relevant cues to recover otherwise missed gold categories.
pattern_tag_definitions.over-propagation-fp-chain: Corr edges trigger cascaded false positives across multiple non-gold categories.
pattern_tag_definitions.localization-drift: Category may be partially right but location/span quality degrades.
pattern_tag_definitions.spurious-correlation-trigger: Corr edge appears to activate unsupported category predictions lacking grounded evidence.
pattern_tag_definitions.already-solved-no-graph-needed: Baseline already solves key gold categories; graph adds little value.
pattern_tag_definitions.shared-upstream-miss: All variants miss the same upstream prerequisite signal, causing downstream failure.
pattern_tag_definitions.ambiguous-gold-location: Gold location mapping itself is noisy/uncertain, limiting definitive localization conclusions.
